skills.description: Write or improve a skill (SKILL.md). Use when saving a reusable procedure with skill_manage, or when a skill turned out wrong or incomplete.
skills.name: skill-authoring

skills.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into cited decisions, owners and follow-ups. Use when asked to extract action items from a meeting, or to reconcile notes with existing work.
skills.name: meeting-action-items

skills.description: Break a large or ambiguous task into verifiable steps before starting. Use when a request spans several files or systems, or when the first step is not obvious.
skills.name: plan-before-acting

skills.description: Run a bounded weekly review over the user's notes and tasks, then propose next week's plan. Use when asked what slipped, what is waiting, or to plan the coming week.
skills.name: weekly-review-planning

skills.description: Measure a codebase with pygount or the shell, to answer how big it is and what it is made of. Use when asked for lines of code, a language breakdown, or code-to-comment ratios.
skills.name: codebase-inspection

skills.description: Work GitHub end to end with the gh CLI: auth, issues, the pull-request lifecycle, reviews and repo management. Use when the task touches a GitHub repository's remote state.
skills.name: github

skills.description: Debug Python with pdb, post-mortem inspection and debugpy remote attach. Use when a traceback does not explain a wrong value, or a long-running process misbehaves.
skills.name: python-debugpy

skills.description: Verify a change before it is committed with a static scan, the test suite and an independent reviewer. Use when finishing a task, or when the user says commit, push, ship or review.
skills.name: requesting-code-review

skills.description: Clean up recent code changes with four focused reviewers running in parallel, then apply only the fixes worth applying. Use when the user says simplify, or asks for a cleanup of what was just written.
skills.name: simplify-code

skills.description: Run throwaway experiments to answer feasibility questions before committing to a build. Use when the user wants to see if something works, or to compare two approaches.
skills.name: spike

skills.description: Find the root cause of a bug before changing code. Use for any failing test, crash, or behaviour that does not match what the code appears to say.
skills.name: systematic-debugging

skills.description: Implement a feature or fix by writing a failing test first. Use when adding behaviour to tested code or when a bug needs a regression test.
skills.name: test-driven-development

skills.description: How to find information when the web_search tool is not available. Use when web_search is not offered and the user asks something that needs current information.
skills.name: working-without-web-search
